name: Coffee Pub Chameleon
tagline: Plan the trip. Talk it through. Keep it all in one place.
description: A private place for your group to plan a trip together. Chat all week, call when it counts, and keep the plans, the places and the budget right beside it. Also works for game nights and projects.
highlights: A chat for your group, with a call when you want one
Itinerary, places on a map, dates and budget in one space
Polls for the choices, and a budget for splitting the costs
Guest access with just a name, if the owner allows it
Also for game nights, with each player as an OBS source, and for projects
No ads, and your data stays in your own group environment
ctaNote: Coming soon. Free and paid options are planned.
pitch: A chat for your group, a call when you want one, and the tools you need beside them: the itinerary, the map, the dates and the budget.
